verification.note: Each row re-verified against both primary sources before publishing: the starter is depth 1 on the club chart, the replacement is the next listed name at that string depth, and the game status matches the official injury report exactly. Green Bay prints leading jersey numbers in the name column; display names are published with the number stripped and the raw printed string retained in starter_raw / replacement_raw. Depth order is the club's printed order, never the jersey number. Club depth charts are self-published (some label themselves unofficial); that caveat rides with every row.
